name: Automatic Call Distributor
description: Omnichannel routing engine that queues inbound contacts, selects the best available resource by skills and priority, and tracks service-level attainment for every queue.
roleInCenter: Traffic control: connects each waiting contact to the right resource at the right priority within SLA budgets.

glossary.definition: Ordered waiting pool for contacts needing a named skill set
An agent capability tag used to match contacts to qualified resources
Bundle of skills or team used as a routing/expansion unit
The ordered rule set deciding which available agent receives the next contact
Percent of contacts answered within a time threshold (e.g. 80/20)
Caller hangs up before an agent connects; measured after a short-abandon filter
Hang-ups under N seconds counted as accidental dials, not true abandons
Re-route waiting contacts to an alternate queue/group when triggers fire (wait, volume)
Agent-to-agent handover with live context conversation before the customer is joined
Caller is moved to another queue with no agent-to-agent context
Real-time estimate of queue hold time announced or used by callback offers
Agent non-availability code (break, training, project) that removes them from routing

children.name: Skills-Based Routing
children.description: Best-fit agent with all required skills

children.name: Longest Idle
children.description: Available agent who has waited longest since last contact

children.name: Business Hours Routing
children.description: After-hours path: IVR message, voicemail, or answering service

children.name: Language Routing
children.description: Language skill gates before skill match

children.name: Negative Skill
children.description: Exclude agents (do-not-route) for conflict, compliance, or burnout reasons

children.name: Preferred / Last-Agent Routing
children.description: Attempt continuity with prior handling agent before general queue

children.name: Short Abandoned
children.description: Hang-up inside short-call threshold; excluded from SL math

children.name: Overflowed Out
children.description: Routed to alternate group or external site

children.name: Deflected Out of Queue
children.description: Rerouted to self-service, SMS link, or async channel before answer

children.name: Conference
children.description: Original agent stays on the line for supervisor or expert support

metrics.name: Service Level Attainment
metrics.definition: Contacts answered within the queue threshold over measured contacts

metrics.name: Abandonment Rate
metrics.definition: True abandons divided by offered contacts

metrics.name: Average Speed of Answer
metrics.definition: Mean wait time for answered contacts

metrics.name: Longest Current/Periodic Wait
metrics.definition: Tail latency for queue waits; SL only captures the threshold boundary

metrics.name: Queue-View FCR Share
metrics.definition: Share of queue contacts with no repeat contact on same intent in window

metrics.name: Handled Volume
metrics.definition: Contacts answered by resources in period

failureModes.name: Skill Starvation
failureModes.signal: One niche queue builds while generalists idle; abandonment concentrated on sparse skills
failureModes.mitigation: Overflow matrix to cross-trained groups; WFM cross-skill planning

failureModes.name: Priority Inversion
failureModes.signal: VIP queue slippage while ordinary traffic answers; priority flag overuse
failureModes.mitigation: Priority budget: restrict flagged volume, review monthly

failureModes.name: Unannounced Long Waits
failureModes.signal: Abandons spike after 90s without EWT announcement
failureModes.mitigation: Expected-wait announcement plus callback offer at threshold

failureModes.name: Ping-Pong Transfers
failureModes.signal: 3+ transfers per contact on a path; repeat contacts on same intent

exchanges: Interval queue stats feed forecasting and intraday alerts
Disposition and wrap codes written back

scoringModel.name: ACD Fluid Routing & Queue Stability Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Evaluates omnichannel queue stability, Halfin-Whitt service-level attainment, skill-affinity matching precision, and context-preserving transfer discipline.

dimensions.name: Service Level & Tail Wait Control
dimensions.description: Attainment of target SLA thresholds alongside bounded P95 tail wait latency and proactive expected-wait callback conversion
sampleCriteria: Queue achieves 80 percent answered within threshold window
Tail wait time P95 remains below 2.5x target SLA threshold
Callback offer triggers automatically when EWT exceeds threshold

dimensions.name: Skill-Affinity Cosine Matching Precision
dimensions.description: Alignment between contact intent skill requirements and assigned agent capability vectors without starving niche queues
sampleCriteria: Assigned agent possesses primary language and domain skill tags
Cosine affinity score between contact vector and agent skill profile exceeds 0.80
Zero negative-skill or compliance-exclusion routing violations

dimensions.name: Dynamic Priority Aging & Overflow Governance
dimensions.description: Smooth priority aging across tiers and timely overflow expansion preventing both skill starvation and priority inversion
sampleCriteria: Aging gradient prevents standard-tier starvation under VIP surges
Overflow matrix expands to cross-trained skill group before abandon spike
Omnichannel blend respects voice preemption without dropping active chats

dimensions.name: Abandonment Hazard Suppression
dimensions.description: Minimization of true post-threshold abandonments through accurate EWT signaling and virtual queue preservation
sampleCriteria: True abandonment rate after short-call filter stays under 5 percent
EWT prediction error remains within 15 percent of actual wait
Callback-converted contacts retain original queue aging timestamp

dimensions.name: Transfer Continuity & Ping-Pong Prevention
dimensions.description: Warm consult execution and preferred-agent continuity eliminating multi-hop cold transfer chains
sampleCriteria: Cold transfers represent fewer than 10 percent of total transfers
Context banner and verified CRM case ID attach across transfer hops
Zero contacts experience 3 or more sequential queue transfers

stateVariables.description: Fluid-limit Erlang-A queue age density of waiting contacts at time t that have accumulated wait time w
Continuous cosine matching field between contact requirement embedding u and available agent capability vector v
Dynamic priority potential of a waiting contact combining base tier priority with continuous wait-time aging gradient
Instantaneous Erlang-A patience hazard rate at which a contact waiting for duration w abandons the queue
Quality-and-Efficiency-Driven (QED) Halfin-Whitt square-root staffing safety coefficient governing delay probability

differentialEquations.name: Fluid-Limit Erlang-A Queue Age Transport PDE
differentialEquations.formula: partial_t q(t, w) + partial_w q(t, w) = - (h_aband(w) + mu_route(t, w)) cdot q(t, w)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Conservation law for waiting contact density across clock time t and wait age w under simultaneous abandonment hazard and routing depletion

differentialEquations.name: Dynamic Priority Aging & Skill Dispatch Flow
differentialEquations.formula: dP_age(t, w) cdot dw^-1 = gamma_tier cdot (1 + alpha_sla cdot exp(kappa_sla cdot (w - tau_sla)))
differentialEquations.interpretation: Priority aging gradient accelerates exponentially as contact wait w approaches and exceeds the queue SLA threshold tau_sla

differentialEquations.name: Halfin-Whitt Heavy-Traffic Queue Diffusion SDE
differentialEquations.formula: dX_hw(t) = - mu_serv cdot (X_hw(t) + beta_hw(t)) dt - theta_aband cdot max(X_hw(t), 0) dt + sqrt(2 cdot mu_serv) dW_t
differentialEquations.interpretation: Rescaled queue length diffusion switches between Ornstein-Uhlenbeck restoring drift when servers are free and abandonment-damped drift in overload

scaleInvariants: Halfin-Whitt QED scaling: spare capacity N - lambda cdot mu^-1 scales as beta_hw cdot sqrt(N), holding delay probability invariant from 50 to 100k+ agents
O(1) bipartite dispatch lookup via quantized spherical locality-sensitive hashing on the skill-affinity cosine field A_skill(u, v)
Conservation of total offered traffic flux: ingress arrivals equal the sum of answered flux, true abandonment integral, and overflow divergence
